mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, leetcode_no, title, difficulty, tags, url, created_at, updated_at FROM problem ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO problem (user_id, leetcode_no, title, difficulty, tags, url) VALUES (#{userId}, #{leetcodeNo}, #{title}, #{difficulty}, #{tags}, #{url})
mapper.update: UPDATE problem SET leetcode_no = #{leetcodeNo}, title = #{title}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, tags = #{tags}, url = #{url} WHERE id = #{id}
